exam.exam_name: Jammu & Kashmir Teacher & Junior Assistant Direct Recruitment Examination
exam.conducting_body: Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB)

source_evidence.captured_wording: Upload latest passport size photograph (20 KB - 50 KB) and signature (10 KB - 20 KB) in JPG format.
source_evidence.document_title: Advertisement for District/Divisional/UT Cadre Posts of School Education Department

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain white/light background; Frontal portrait with both ears visible

requirements.requirement_name: Domicile Certificate of UT of J&K
requirements.content_instructions: PDF; 100 KB to 300 KB PDF scan; A4 original document; Mandatory qualification under Jammu and Kashmir Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules 2020; candidates without J&K Domicile are ineligible

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Advertisement for District/Divisional/UT Cadre Posts of School Education Department - Section 7 (Instructions for Online Application) (https://jkssb.nic.in/Pdf/Advt04of2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Advertisement for District/Divisional/UT Cadre Posts of School Education Department - Section 7 (Instructions for Online Application) (https://jkssb.nic.in/Pdf/Advt04of2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
